{"parentUuid":"90dd7859-7ac3-4750-9b6c-fbd45d52889b","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"2aef766b-ab88-4630-8ee5-e3473f8fa18d","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01BjGixsogtwynEVnBiAoMmG","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Chart images: the PNG, JPEG, or WebP pictures a Data Bite or Report shows in\nits Markdown body as `image:<name>` (ADR-004).\n\nAn image belongs to one item, named here by its kind (\"data-bites\" or\n\"reports\") and id, and is stored at settings.UPLOADS/images/<kind>/<id>/<name>,\noutside site/. The files there are the record; there is no table. An image's\nname is its upload's filename, sanitized and lowercased, so it is safe in a\npath and in a URL, and uploading a name the item already has replaces that\nimage.\n\nAn upload is checked the way app.uploads checks a Report's PDF: the extension\nand the browser's declared type must agree, and then the bytes must carry that\nformat's signature. There is no image library (pyproject.toml is fixed), so\nthe check is by signature, not by decoding. SVG is refused: it is a document\nthat can carry script.\n\nWho may add or remove an item's images is decided by that item's module, not\nhere.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport shutil\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import UploadFile\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse\n\nfrom app import settings, uploads\nfrom app.content import ContentError\n\nMIB = uploads.MIB\nMAX_BYTES = 5 * MIB\nMAX_PER_ITEM = 10\nKINDS = {\"data-bites\": \"Data Bite\", \"reports\": \"Report\"}  # kind: noun, for messages\n# How near the end a format's end marker must be, allowing for trailing bytes.\n_TAIL = 1024\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass _Format:\n    label: str\n    media_type: str\n    looks_valid: Callable[[bytes], bool]\n\n\ndef _png(data: bytes) -> bool:\n    # The 8-byte signature, and the IEND chunk (with its fixed CRC) at the end.\n    return data.startswith(b\"\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n\") and b\"IEND\\xaeB`\\x82\" in data[-_TAIL:]\n\n\ndef _jpeg(data: bytes) -> bool:\n    # Start-of-image, then end-of-image at the end.\n    return data.startswith(b\"\\xff\\xd8\\xff\") and b\"\\xff\\xd9\" in data[-_TAIL:]\n\n\ndef _webp(data: bytes) -> bool:\n    # A RIFF container of type WEBP, holding at least as many bytes as it says.\n    return (data[:4] == b\"RIFF\" and data[8:12] == b\"WEBP\"\n            and int.from_bytes(data[4:8], \"little\") + 8 <= len(data))\n\n\n_PNG = _Format(\"PNG\", \"image/png\", _png)\n_JPEG = _Format(\"JPEG\", \"image/jpeg\", _jpeg)\n_FORMATS = {\"png\": _PNG, \"jpg\": _JPEG, \"jpeg\": _JPEG, \"webp\": _Format(\"WebP\", \"image/webp\", _webp)}\n# What read() can name an image. Anything else, e.g. from a URL, names none.\n_NAME = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9_-]+\\.(?:png|jpe?g|webp)\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Image:\n    name: str   # sanitized: safe in a path and a URL\n    data: bytes\n\n\ndef read(upload: UploadFile | None) -> Image:\n    \"\"\"The upload as a checked image. ContentError, with a message safe to\n    show, if no file was chosen or it is not an acceptable image.\"\"\"\n    if upload is None or not upload.filename:\n        raise ContentError(\"Choose an image to upload.\")\n    stem, extension = uploads.split_filename(upload.filename)\n    image_format = _FORMATS.get(extension)\n    if image_format is None or upload.content_type != image_format.media_type:\n        raise ContentError(\"Only PNG, JPEG, or WebP images can be uploaded.\")\n    data = upload.file.read(MAX_BYTES + 1)\n    if len(data) > MAX_BYTES:\n        raise ContentError(f\"That image is over the {MAX_BYTES // MIB} MB limit.\")\n    if not image_format.looks_valid(data):\n        raise ContentError(f\"That file is not a valid {image_format.label} image.\")\n    return Image(f\"{uploads.safe_stem(stem, 'chart').lower()}.{extension}\", data)\n\n\ndef response(path: Path) -> FileResponse:\n    \"\"\"A stored image, served as its type and never sniffed as anything else.\"\"\"\n    return FileResponse(path, media_type=_FORMATS[path.suffix[1:]].media_type,\n                        headers={\"X-Content-Type-Options\": \"nosniff\"})\n\n\ndef _folder(kind: str, item_id: int) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where an item's images are stored. Built from fixed kinds and the id.\"\"\"\n    if kind not in KINDS:\n        raise ValueError(kind)\n    return settings.UPLOADS / \"images\" / kind / str(int(item_id))\n\n\ndef stored(kind: str, item_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The item's images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n    folder = _folder(kind, item_id)\n    if not folder.is_dir():\n        return {}\n    return {path.name: path for path in sorted(folder.iterdir())\n            if _NAME.fullmatch(path.name) and path.is_file()}\n\n\ndef save(kind: str, item_id: int, image: Image) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Add the image to the item, or replace the one of the same name.\n    ContentError if that would be one more than MAX_PER_ITEM.\"\"\"\n    existing = stored(kind, item_id)\n    if image.name not in existing and len(existing) >= MAX_PER_ITEM:\n        raise ContentError(f\"This {KINDS[kind]} already has {MAX_PER_ITEM} images, the \"\n                           \"most allowed. Delete one to add another.\")\n    uploads.write_atomically(_folder(kind, item_id) / image.name, image.data)\n\n\ndef remove(kind: str, item_id: int, name: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"False if the item has no image of that name.\"\"\"\n    path = stored(kind, item_id).get(name)\n    if path is None:\n        return False\n    path.unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    return True\n\n\ndef remove_all(kind: str, item_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Remove every image the item has. Raises if one can't be removed, rather\n    than leave it for another item that is later given the same id.\"\"\"\n    folder = _folder(kind, item_id)\n    if folder.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(folder)\n\"\"\"What Data Bites and Reports share: the title/slug/Markdown-body fields, their\nvalidation, the draft/published status, and the table-level reads and writes.\n\nEach content type keeps its own table, so a slug is unique within a type but a\nData Bite and a Report may share one (spec #1, \"Publish gate & export paths\":\nexports are namespaced by type). Who may do what is decided by each type's own\nmodule and routes, not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import db\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\nAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n# A slug names its item's page, <type folder>/<slug>.html, on the public site;\n# <type folder>/index.html is taken by the type's list page.\n_RESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\nclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    pass\n\n\ndef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\")\n    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\")\n    if slug in _RESERVED_SLUGS:\n        raise ContentError(f\"The slug {slug} is reserved for the list page; \"\n                           \"choose another.\")\n    if not body.strip():\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a body.\")\n    return title, slug, body\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ContentTable:\n    \"\"\"One content type's table. `table` is a fixed identifier from this\n    codebase, never user input.\"\"\"\n    table: str  # e.g. \"reports\"\n    noun: str   # e.g. \"Report\", for messages\n\n    def _select(self, where: str, order: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name FROM {self.table} c\"\n                f\" JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE {where} ORDER BY {order}\",\n                params,\n            ).fetchall()\n\n    def _duplicate_slug_error(self, exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError, slug: str) -> DuplicateSlug:\n        \"\"\"Translate the slug's UNIQUE violation; re-raise any other constraint.\"\"\"\n        if f\"{self.table}.slug\" not in str(exc):\n            raise exc\n        return DuplicateSlug(f\"Another {self.noun} already uses the slug {slug}.\")\n\n    def create(self, title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n               also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Create a draft.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                item_id = conn.execute(\n                    f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} (title, slug, body, author_id)\"\n                    \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, author_id),\n                ).lastrowid\n                if also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n        return item_id\n\n    def update(self, item_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n               drafts_only: bool = False, also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. The author, created_at, and status are\n        kept. With drafts_only, a published item is left alone. False if\n        nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                changed = conn.execute(\n                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?,\"\n                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, item_id, drafts_only),\n                ).rowcount == 1\n                if changed and also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n                return changed\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n\n    def touch(self, item_id: int, *, also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Mark the item as changed now, for a change outside its row (e.g.\n        its images), made by `also` in the same transaction. False if there is\n        no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            changed = conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?\",\n                (item_id,),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n            if changed and also:\n                also(conn, item_id)\n            return changed\n\n    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        rows = self._select(\"c.id = ?\", \"c.id\", (item_id,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def list_all(self, status: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        \"\"\"Every item, or only those in `status`; most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n        where, params = (\"1\", ()) if status is None else (\"c.status = ?\", (status,))\n        return self._select(where, \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\", params)\n\n    def count_by_status(self) -> dict[str, int]:\n        \"\"\"How many items are in each status, zero included, e.g.\n        {\"draft\": 2, \"published\": 0}.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {self.table} GROUP BY status\").fetchall()\n        return {**dict.fromkeys(STATUS_LABELS, 0), **dict(rows)}\n\n    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)\n\n    def get_published(self, slug: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        \"\"\"The published item with this slug; None for a draft or no such item.\"\"\"\n        rows = self._select(\"c.status = 'published' AND c.slug = ?\", \"c.id\", (slug,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def set_status(self, item_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Publish or unpublish. False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ?\",\n                (status, item_id),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n\n    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).rowcount == 1\n\"\"\"Data Bites: short, dated Markdown items.\n\nAny Analyst or Director may create, edit, publish, and unpublish any Data Bite,\nand add or remove its chart images (shift continuity, ADR-003, ADR-004); only\na Director may delete one, which the routes enforce. Editing never changes the\nauthor or created_at. Deleting a Data Bite deletes its images.\n\nPublic-facing code reads Data Bites only through `list_published` and\n`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import chart_images\nfrom app.content import ContentTable\n\n_TABLE = ContentTable(\"data_bites\", \"Data Bite\")\n_IMAGES = \"data-bites\"  # the chart_images kind\n\nget = _TABLE.get\nlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\ncount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\nset_status = _TABLE.set_status\nget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n\n\ndef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft. It starts with no images, even if a deleted Data Bite\n    that had its id left some behind (SQLite may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id,\n                         also=lambda conn, bite_id: chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id))\n\n\ndef update(bite_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.update(bite_id, title, slug, body)\n\n\ndef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Data Bites only, newest first.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n\n\ndef delete(bite_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the Data Bite and its images. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    if not _TABLE.delete(bite_id):\n        return False\n    chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n    return True\n\n\ndef images(bite_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The Data Bite's chart images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n    return chart_images.stored(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n\n\ndef add_image(bite_id: int, image: chart_images.Image) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Add a chart image, or replace the one of the same name. False if there\n    is no such Data Bite; ContentError if it already has the most allowed.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.touch(bite_id, also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.save(\n        _IMAGES, item_id, image))\n\n\ndef remove_image(bite_id: int, name: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"False if there is no such Data Bite or it has no image of that name.\"\"\"\n    if name not in images(bite_id) or not _TABLE.touch(bite_id):\n        return False\n    return chart_images.remove(_IMAGES, bite_id, name)\n\"\"\"Reports: durable, cite-able Markdown documents (the Factbook, the CDS).\n\nAny Analyst or Director may create a Report (always as a draft) and edit a\ndraft one, whoever started it (shift continuity, ADR-003). Once a Report is\npublished only a Director may change it: `update` enforces that in the same\nstatement that writes, and the routes make publish, unpublish, and delete\nDirector only. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n\nA Report may carry one attached PDF (checked by app.uploads). Attaching,\nreplacing, or removing it follows the same lockdown as the body. The file is\nstored under settings.UPLOADS, outside site/, named by the Report's id; the\n`file_name` column says whether there is one.\n\nPublic-facing code reads Reports only through `list_published` and\n`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.content import AlsoWrite, ContentError, ContentTable\nfrom app.uploads import Pdf, write_atomically\nfrom app.users import is_director\n\n_TABLE = ContentTable(\"reports\", \"Report\")\n\nget = _TABLE.get\nlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\ncount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\nset_status = _TABLE.set_status\nget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n\n\nclass ReportLocked(ContentError):\n    \"\"\"A published Report, and the user is not a Director.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef can_edit(report: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"The lockdown rule. `update` and `remove_file` apply the same rule in\n    their UPDATEs.\"\"\"\n    return report[\"status\"] == \"draft\" or is_director(user)\n\n\ndef file_path(report_id: int) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where a Report's attached file is stored. Built from the id alone.\"\"\"\n    return settings.UPLOADS / \"reports\" / f\"{int(report_id)}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef _attaching(pdf: Pdf | None) -> AlsoWrite | None:\n    \"\"\"Attach `pdf` in the same transaction as the Report's row, so the body\n    and the file are saved together or not at all.\"\"\"\n    if pdf is None:\n        return None\n\n    def attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE reports SET file_name = ? WHERE id = ?\", (pdf.name, report_id))\n        write_atomically(file_path(report_id), pdf.data)\n\n    return attach\n\n\ndef _missing_or_locked(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"After a guarded write changed nothing: False if there is no such\n    Report, otherwise it was published and locked.\"\"\"\n    if get(report_id) is None:\n        return False\n    raise ReportLocked(\"Only the Director can change a published Report.\")\n\n\ndef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n           pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft Report, with its file if one is given.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id, also=_attaching(pdf))\n\n\ndef update(report_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n           user: sqlite3.Row, pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body on behalf of `user`, and attach or replace\n    the file if one is given. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked if\n    it is published and `user` is not a Director.\"\"\"\n    if _TABLE.update(report_id, title, slug, body, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                     also=_attaching(pdf)):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef remove_file(report_id: int, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Remove the Report's file on behalf of `user`, as `update`.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        removed = conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE reports SET file_name = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n            \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR ?)\",\n            (report_id, is_director(user)),\n        ).rowcount == 1\n    if not removed:\n        return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n    # Only once the row no longer names it, so a failed commit keeps the file.\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    return True\n\n\ndef delete(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the Report and its file. False if there is no such Report.\"\"\"\n    if not _TABLE.delete(report_id):\n        return False\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    return True\n\n\ndef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Reports only, by title.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.title, c.id\")\n\"\"\"Checking a file uploaded to be a Report's attached file, and the pieces every\nupload shares (app.chart_images uses them too): a safe name from the\nuploaded one, and an atomic write.\n\nOnly PDFs are accepted (spec #1, story 27). The filename's extension and the\nbrowser's declared type must both say PDF, and then the bytes themselves must\nlook like a PDF: the browser's word is never enough. The uploaded filename is\nkept only as a sanitized display name. Storage paths are built from the\nReport's id, never from anything the uploader sent.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport re\nimport tempfile\nimport unicodedata\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import UploadFile\n\nfrom app.content import ContentError\n\nMIB = 1024 * 1024\nMAX_BYTES = 20 * MIB\n_DECLARED_TYPES = {\"application/pdf\", \"application/x-pdf\"}\n# A PDF starts with this header, and its end-of-file marker sits at (or,\n# allowing for trailing whitespace or junk, near) the end.\n_HEADER = b\"%PDF-\"\n_EOF_MARKER = b\"%%EOF\"\n_EOF_WINDOW = 1024\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Pdf:\n    name: str   # sanitized, for display and the download's filename\n    data: bytes\n\n\ndef safe_stem(stem: str, fallback: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A safe name from an uploaded name's stem: ASCII letters, digits,\n    hyphens, and underscores only, so no path separators, dots, quotes, or\n    control characters survive. `fallback` if nothing does.\"\"\"\n    ascii_stem = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", stem).encode(\"ascii\", \"ignore\").decode()\n    return re.sub(r\"[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+\", \"-\", ascii_stem).strip(\"-_\")[:100] or fallback\n\n\ndef sanitize_filename(stem: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A safe display name for a Report's PDF, from the uploaded name (without\n    its extension).\"\"\"\n    return f\"{safe_stem(stem, 'report')}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef split_filename(filename: str) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"(stem, lowercased extension) of an uploaded filename; the extension is\n    \"\" if there is none. A browser sends a bare name, but anyone can send a\n    path, so only its last part counts.\"\"\"\n    base = re.split(r\"[\\\\/]\", filename)[-1]\n    stem, dot, extension = base.rpartition(\".\")\n    return (stem, extension.lower()) if dot else (base, \"\")\n\n\ndef read_pdf(upload: UploadFile | None) -> Pdf | None:\n    \"\"\"The upload as a checked PDF, or None if no file was chosen. ContentError,\n    with a message safe to show, if it is not an acceptable PDF.\"\"\"\n    if upload is None or not upload.filename:\n        return None\n    stem, extension = split_filename(upload.filename)\n    if extension != \"pdf\" or upload.content_type not in _DECLARED_TYPES:\n        raise ContentError(\"Only PDF files can be attached.\")\n    data = upload.file.read(MAX_BYTES + 1)\n    if len(data) > MAX_BYTES:\n        raise ContentError(f\"That file is over the {MAX_BYTES // MIB} MB limit.\")\n    if not (data.startswith(_HEADER) and _EOF_MARKER in data[-_EOF_WINDOW:]):\n        raise ContentError(\"That file is not a valid PDF.\")\n    return Pdf(sanitize_filename(stem), data)\n\n\ndef write_atomically(path: Path, data: bytes) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace `path` in one step, so a failed write never leaves half a file.\n    The temporary file ends in .part while it is written.\"\"\"\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, suffix=\".part\")\n    try:\n        with os.fdopen(fd, \"wb\") as f:\n            f.write(data)\n        os.replace(tmp, path)\n    except BaseException:\n        Path(tmp).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n        raise","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"a1fff5aa-5771-488b-a1c2-34cb5f4f92d6","timestamp":"2026-09-29T18:09:05.549Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"Chart images: the PNG, JPEG, or WebP pictures a Data Bite or Report shows in\nits Markdown body as `image:<name>` (ADR-004).\n\nAn image belongs to one item, named here by its kind (\"data-bites\" or\n\"reports\") and id, and is stored at settings.UPLOADS/images/<kind>/<id>/<name>,\noutside site/. The files there are the record; there is no table. An image's\nname is its upload's filename, sanitized and lowercased, so it is safe in a\npath and in a URL, and uploading a name the item already has replaces that\nimage.\n\nAn upload is checked the way app.uploads checks a Report's PDF: the extension\nand the browser's declared type must agree, and then the bytes must carry that\nformat's signature. There is no image library (pyproject.toml is fixed), so\nthe check is by signature, not by decoding. SVG is refused: it is a document\nthat can carry script.\n\nWho may add or remove an item's images is decided by that item's module, not\nhere.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport shutil\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import UploadFile\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse\n\nfrom app import settings, uploads\nfrom app.content import ContentError\n\nMIB = uploads.MIB\nMAX_BYTES = 5 * MIB\nMAX_PER_ITEM = 10\nKINDS = {\"data-bites\": \"Data Bite\", \"reports\": \"Report\"}  # kind: noun, for messages\n# How near the end a format's end marker must be, allowing for trailing bytes.\n_TAIL = 1024\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass _Format:\n    label: str\n    media_type: str\n    looks_valid: Callable[[bytes], bool]\n\n\ndef _png(data: bytes) -> bool:\n    # The 8-byte signature, and the IEND chunk (with its fixed CRC) at the end.\n    return data.startswith(b\"\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n\") and b\"IEND\\xaeB`\\x82\" in data[-_TAIL:]\n\n\ndef _jpeg(data: bytes) -> bool:\n    # Start-of-image, then end-of-image at the end.\n    return data.startswith(b\"\\xff\\xd8\\xff\") and b\"\\xff\\xd9\" in data[-_TAIL:]\n\n\ndef _webp(data: bytes) -> bool:\n    # A RIFF container of type WEBP, holding at least as many bytes as it says.\n    return (data[:4] == b\"RIFF\" and data[8:12] == b\"WEBP\"\n            and int.from_bytes(data[4:8], \"little\") + 8 <= len(data))\n\n\n_PNG = _Format(\"PNG\", \"image/png\", _png)\n_JPEG = _Format(\"JPEG\", \"image/jpeg\", _jpeg)\n_FORMATS = {\"png\": _PNG, \"jpg\": _JPEG, \"jpeg\": _JPEG, \"webp\": _Format(\"WebP\", \"image/webp\", _webp)}\n# What read() can name an image. Anything else, e.g. from a URL, names none.\n_NAME = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9_-]+\\.(?:png|jpe?g|webp)\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Image:\n    name: str   # sanitized: safe in a path and a URL\n    data: bytes\n\n\ndef read(upload: UploadFile | None) -> Image:\n    \"\"\"The upload as a checked image. ContentError, with a message safe to\n    show, if no file was chosen or it is not an acceptable image.\"\"\"\n    if upload is None or not upload.filename:\n        raise ContentError(\"Choose an image to upload.\")\n    stem, extension = uploads.split_filename(upload.filename)\n    image_format = _FORMATS.get(extension)\n    if image_format is None or upload.content_type != image_format.media_type:\n        raise ContentError(\"Only PNG, JPEG, or WebP images can be uploaded.\")\n    data = upload.file.read(MAX_BYTES + 1)\n    if len(data) > MAX_BYTES:\n        raise ContentError(f\"That image is over the {MAX_BYTES // MIB} MB limit.\")\n    if not image_format.looks_valid(data):\n        raise ContentError(f\"That file is not a valid {image_format.label} image.\")\n    return Image(f\"{uploads.safe_stem(stem, 'chart').lower()}.{extension}\", data)\n\n\ndef response(path: Path) -> FileResponse:\n    \"\"\"A stored image, served as its type and never sniffed as anything else.\"\"\"\n    return FileResponse(path, media_type=_FORMATS[path.suffix[1:]].media_type,\n                        headers={\"X-Content-Type-Options\": \"nosniff\"})\n\n\ndef _folder(kind: str, item_id: int) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where an item's images are stored. Built from fixed kinds and the id.\"\"\"\n    if kind not in KINDS:\n        raise ValueError(kind)\n    return settings.UPLOADS / \"images\" / kind / str(int(item_id))\n\n\ndef stored(kind: str, item_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The item's images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n    folder = _folder(kind, item_id)\n    if not folder.is_dir():\n        return {}\n    return {path.name: path for path in sorted(folder.iterdir())\n            if _NAME.fullmatch(path.name) and path.is_file()}\n\n\ndef save(kind: str, item_id: int, image: Image) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Add the image to the item, or replace the one of the same name.\n    ContentError if that would be one more than MAX_PER_ITEM.\"\"\"\n    existing = stored(kind, item_id)\n    if image.name not in existing and len(existing) >= MAX_PER_ITEM:\n        raise ContentError(f\"This {KINDS[kind]} already has {MAX_PER_ITEM} images, the \"\n                           \"most allowed. Delete one to add another.\")\n    uploads.write_atomically(_folder(kind, item_id) / image.name, image.data)\n\n\ndef remove(kind: str, item_id: int, name: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"False if the item has no image of that name.\"\"\"\n    path = stored(kind, item_id).get(name)\n    if path is None:\n        return False\n    path.unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    return True\n\n\ndef remove_all(kind: str, item_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Remove every image the item has. Raises if one can't be removed, rather\n    than leave it for another item that is later given the same id.\"\"\"\n    folder = _folder(kind, item_id)\n    if folder.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(folder)\n\"\"\"What Data Bites and Reports share: the title/slug/Markdown-body fields, their\nvalidation, the draft/published status, and the table-level reads and writes.\n\nEach content type keeps its own table, so a slug is unique within a type but a\nData Bite and a Report may share one (spec #1, \"Publish gate & export paths\":\nexports are namespaced by type). Who may do what is decided by each type's own\nmodule and routes, not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import db\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\nAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n# A slug names its item's page, <type folder>/<slug>.html, on the public site;\n# <type folder>/index.html is taken by the type's list page.\n_RESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\nclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    pass\n\n\ndef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\")\n    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\")\n    if slug in _RESERVED_SLUGS:\n        raise ContentError(f\"The slug {slug} is reserved for the list page; \"\n                           \"choose another.\")\n    if not body.strip():\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a body.\")\n    return title, slug, body\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ContentTable:\n    \"\"\"One content type's table. `table` is a fixed identifier from this\n    codebase, never user input.\"\"\"\n    table: str  # e.g. \"reports\"\n    noun: str   # e.g. \"Report\", for messages\n\n    def _select(self, where: str, order: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name FROM {self.table} c\"\n                f\" JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE {where} ORDER BY {order}\",\n                params,\n            ).fetchall()\n\n    def _duplicate_slug_error(self, exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError, slug: str) -> DuplicateSlug:\n        \"\"\"Translate the slug's UNIQUE violation; re-raise any other constraint.\"\"\"\n        if f\"{self.table}.slug\" not in str(exc):\n            raise exc\n        return DuplicateSlug(f\"Another {self.noun} already uses the slug {slug}.\")\n\n    def create(self, title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n               also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Create a draft.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                item_id = conn.execute(\n                    f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} (title, slug, body, author_id)\"\n                    \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, author_id),\n                ).lastrowid\n                if also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n        return item_id\n\n    def update(self, item_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n               drafts_only: bool = False, also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. The author, created_at, and status are\n        kept. With drafts_only, a published item is left alone. False if\n        nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                changed = conn.execute(\n                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?,\"\n                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, item_id, drafts_only),\n                ).rowcount == 1\n                if changed and also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n                return changed\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n\n    def touch(self, item_id: int, *, also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Mark the item as changed now, for a change outside its row (e.g.\n        its images), made by `also` in the same transaction. False if there is\n        no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            changed = conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?\",\n                (item_id,),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n            if changed and also:\n                also(conn, item_id)\n            return changed\n\n    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        rows = self._select(\"c.id = ?\", \"c.id\", (item_id,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def list_all(self, status: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        \"\"\"Every item, or only those in `status`; most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n        where, params = (\"1\", ()) if status is None else (\"c.status = ?\", (status,))\n        return self._select(where, \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\", params)\n\n    def count_by_status(self) -> dict[str, int]:\n        \"\"\"How many items are in each status, zero included, e.g.\n        {\"draft\": 2, \"published\": 0}.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {self.table} GROUP BY status\").fetchall()\n        return {**dict.fromkeys(STATUS_LABELS, 0), **dict(rows)}\n\n    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)\n\n    def get_published(self, slug: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        \"\"\"The published item with this slug; None for a draft or no such item.\"\"\"\n        rows = self._select(\"c.status = 'published' AND c.slug = ?\", \"c.id\", (slug,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def set_status(self, item_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Publish or unpublish. False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ?\",\n                (status, item_id),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n\n    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).rowcount == 1\n\"\"\"Data Bites: short, dated Markdown items.\n\nAny Analyst or Director may create, edit, publish, and unpublish any Data Bite,\nand add or remove its chart images (shift continuity, ADR-003, ADR-004); only\na Director may delete one, which the routes enforce. Editing never changes the\nauthor or created_at. Deleting a Data Bite deletes its images.\n\nPublic-facing code reads Data Bites only through `list_published` and\n`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import chart_images\nfrom app.content import ContentTable\n\n_TABLE = ContentTable(\"data_bites\", \"Data Bite\")\n_IMAGES = \"data-bites\"  # the chart_images kind\n\nget = _TABLE.get\nlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\ncount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\nset_status = _TABLE.set_status\nget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n\n\ndef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft. It starts with no images, even if a deleted Data Bite\n    that had its id left some behind (SQLite may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id,\n                         also=lambda conn, bite_id: chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id))\n\n\ndef update(bite_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.update(bite_id, title, slug, body)\n\n\ndef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Data Bites only, newest first.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n\n\ndef delete(bite_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the Data Bite and its images. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    if not _TABLE.delete(bite_id):\n        return False\n    chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n    return True\n\n\ndef images(bite_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The Data Bite's chart images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n    return chart_images.stored(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n\n\ndef add_image(bite_id: int, image: chart_images.Image) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Add a chart image, or replace the one of the same name. False if there\n    is no such Data Bite; ContentError if it already has the most allowed.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.touch(bite_id, also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.save(\n        _IMAGES, item_id, image))\n\n\ndef remove_image(bite_id: int, name: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"False if there is no such Data Bite or it has no image of that name.\"\"\"\n    if name not in images(bite_id) or not _TABLE.touch(bite_id):\n        return False\n    return chart_images.remove(_IMAGES, bite_id, name)\n\"\"\"Reports: durable, cite-able Markdown documents (the Factbook, the CDS).\n\nAny Analyst or Director may create a Report (always as a draft) and edit a\ndraft one, whoever started it (shift continuity, ADR-003). Once a Report is\npublished only a Director may change it: `update` enforces that in the same\nstatement that writes, and the routes make publish, unpublish, and delete\nDirector only. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n\nA Report may carry one attached PDF (checked by app.uploads). Attaching,\nreplacing, or removing it follows the same lockdown as the body. The file is\nstored under settings.UPLOADS, outside site/, named by the Report's id; the\n`file_name` column says whether there is one.\n\nPublic-facing code reads Reports only through `list_published` and\n`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.content import AlsoWrite, ContentError, ContentTable\nfrom app.uploads import Pdf, write_atomically\nfrom app.users import is_director\n\n_TABLE = ContentTable(\"reports\", \"Report\")\n\nget = _TABLE.get\nlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\ncount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\nset_status = _TABLE.set_status\nget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n\n\nclass ReportLocked(ContentError):\n    \"\"\"A published Report, and the user is not a Director.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef can_edit(report: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"The lockdown rule. `update` and `remove_file` apply the same rule in\n    their UPDATEs.\"\"\"\n    return report[\"status\"] == \"draft\" or is_director(user)\n\n\ndef file_path(report_id: int) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where a Report's attached file is stored. Built from the id alone.\"\"\"\n    return settings.UPLOADS / \"reports\" / f\"{int(report_id)}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef _attaching(pdf: Pdf | None) -> AlsoWrite | None:\n    \"\"\"Attach `pdf` in the same transaction as the Report's row, so the body\n    and the file are saved together or not at all.\"\"\"\n    if pdf is None:\n        return None\n\n    def attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE reports SET file_name = ? WHERE id = ?\", (pdf.name, report_id))\n        write_atomically(file_path(report_id), pdf.data)\n\n    return attach\n\n\ndef _missing_or_locked(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"After a guarded write changed nothing: False if there is no such\n    Report, otherwise it was published and locked.\"\"\"\n    if get(report_id) is None:\n        return False\n    raise ReportLocked(\"Only the Director can change a published Report.\")\n\n\ndef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n           pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft Report, with its file if one is given.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id, also=_attaching(pdf))\n\n\ndef update(report_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n           user: sqlite3.Row, pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body on behalf of `user`, and attach or replace\n    the file if one is given. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked if\n    it is published and `user` is not a Director.\"\"\"\n    if _TABLE.update(report_id, title, slug, body, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                     also=_attaching(pdf)):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef remove_file(report_id: int, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Remove the Report's file on behalf of `user`, as `update`.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        removed = conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE reports SET file_name = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n            \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR ?)\",\n            (report_id, is_director(user)),\n        ).rowcount == 1\n    if not removed:\n        return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n    # Only once the row no longer names it, so a failed commit keeps the file.\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    return True\n\n\ndef delete(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the Report and its file. False if there is no such Report.\"\"\"\n    if not _TABLE.delete(report_id):\n        return False\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    return True\n\n\ndef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Reports only, by title.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.title, c.id\")\n\"\"\"Checking a file uploaded to be a Report's attached file, and the pieces every\nupload shares (app.chart_images uses them too): a safe name from the\nuploaded one, and an atomic write.\n\nOnly PDFs are accepted (spec #1, story 27). The filename's extension and the\nbrowser's declared type must both say PDF, and then the bytes themselves must\nlook like a PDF: the browser's word is never enough. The uploaded filename is\nkept only as a sanitized display name. Storage paths are built from the\nReport's id, never from anything the uploader sent.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport re\nimport tempfile\nimport unicodedata\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import UploadFile\n\nfrom app.content import ContentError\n\nMIB = 1024 * 1024\nMAX_BYTES = 20 * MIB\n_DECLARED_TYPES = {\"application/pdf\", \"application/x-pdf\"}\n# A PDF starts with this header, and its end-of-file marker sits at (or,\n# allowing for trailing whitespace or junk, near) the end.\n_HEADER = b\"%PDF-\"\n_EOF_MARKER = b\"%%EOF\"\n_EOF_WINDOW = 1024\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Pdf:\n    name: str   # sanitized, for display and the download's filename\n    data: bytes\n\n\ndef safe_stem(stem: str, fallback: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A safe name from an uploaded name's stem: ASCII letters, digits,\n    hyphens, and underscores only, so no path separators, dots, quotes, or\n    control characters survive. `fallback` if nothing does.\"\"\"\n    ascii_stem = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", stem).encode(\"ascii\", \"ignore\").decode()\n    return re.sub(r\"[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+\", \"-\", ascii_stem).strip(\"-_\")[:100] or fallback\n\n\ndef sanitize_filename(stem: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A safe display name for a Report's PDF, from the uploaded name (without\n    its extension).\"\"\"\n    return f\"{safe_stem(stem, 'report')}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef split_filename(filename: str) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"(stem, lowercased extension) of an uploaded filename; the extension is\n    \"\" if there is none. A browser sends a bare name, but anyone can send a\n    path, so only its last part counts.\"\"\"\n    base = re.split(r\"[\\\\/]\", filename)[-1]\n    stem, dot, extension = base.rpartition(\".\")\n    return (stem, extension.lower()) if dot else (base, \"\")\n\n\ndef read_pdf(upload: UploadFile | None) -> Pdf | None:\n    \"\"\"The upload as a checked PDF, or None if no file was chosen. ContentError,\n    with a message safe to show, if it is not an acceptable PDF.\"\"\"\n    if upload is None or not upload.filename:\n        return None\n    stem, extension = split_filename(upload.filename)\n    if extension != \"pdf\" or upload.content_type not in _DECLARED_TYPES:\n        raise ContentError(\"Only PDF files can be attached.\")\n    data = upload.file.read(MAX_BYTES + 1)\n    if len(data) > MAX_BYTES:\n        raise ContentError(f\"That file is over the {MAX_BYTES // MIB} MB limit.\")\n    if not (data.startswith(_HEADER) and _EOF_MARKER in data[-_EOF_WINDOW:]):\n        raise ContentError(\"That file is not a valid PDF.\")\n    return Pdf(sanitize_filename(stem), data)\n\n\ndef write_atomically(path: Path, data: bytes) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace `path` in one step, so a failed write never leaves half a file.\n    The temporary file ends in .part while it is written.\"\"\"\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, suffix=\".part\")\n    try:\n        with os.fdopen(fd, \"wb\") as f:\n            f.write(data)\n        os.replace(tmp, path)\n    except BaseException:\n        Path(tmp).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n        raise","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"90dd7859-7ac3-4750-9b6c-fbd45d52889b","session_id":"fc138a42-1eee-4017-bff2-c6a77302f820","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"60601091-56d6-4fd4-8e11-800778552d46","version":"2.1.284","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"d742430b-7559-474c-9216-25f7913def8b","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"2aef766b-ab88-4630-8ee5-e3473f8fa18d","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01QXpcbnpnZiGfyT86SDJus6","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"The public site: every page a visitor can see, each described by the path\nit has in the exported site (e.g. \"data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\").\n\nThe app serves these pages at those same paths (app.routes.public), and\n`cms publish` writes them there (app.publish), so the two render one set of pages\nrather than two. Pages link to each other relatively, through `root` (\"\" at\nthe top of the site, \"../\" one folder down), so the same HTML works served\nfrom / and exported to a GitHub Pages subfolder. Where each kind of page or\nfile sits is decided here, by the *_path functions, and nowhere else.\n\nContent is read only through the published-only queries (`list_published`,\n`get_published`), so a draft cannot reach a page, a link, or the navigation.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports, settings\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* The public site's one stylesheet, at style.css in the site's root. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\n.header-home { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n.nav-site ul { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 1rem; list-style: none; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; padding: 0; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n/* Markdown tables, in a Data Bite's or Report's body. A wide one scrolls\n   sideways in its wrapper (app.rendering.TABLE_SCROLL) rather than widening\n   the page; on a phone, rather than squeezing its text to a word a line. */\n.content-body .content-table-scroll { margin-block: 1rem; overflow-x: auto; }\n/* Chart images (app.chart_images) shrink to the column, keeping their shape. */\n.content-body img { height: auto; max-width: 100%; }\n.content-body table { border-collapse: collapse; }\n.content-body th, .content-body td { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; }\n.content-body th { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent); font-weight: 600; }\n@media (max-width: 40rem) { .content-body th, .content-body td { min-width: 10ch; } }\n\"\"\"\nRECENT_DATA_BITES = 5  # on the home page; the rest are on the Data Bites list\n\n\ndef data_bite_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"data-bites/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef data_bite_image_path(slug: str, name: str) -> str:\n    return f\"images/data-bites/{slug}/{name}\"\n\n\ndef report_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"reports/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef report_file_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    # each described by the path\nit has in the exported site (e.g. \"data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\").\n\nThe app serves these pages at those same paths (app.routes.public), and\n`cms publish` writes them there (app.publish), so the two render one set of pages\nrather than two. Pages link to each other relatively, through `root` (\"\" at\nthe top of the site, \"../\" one folder down), so the same HTML works served\nfrom / and exported to a GitHub Pages subfolder. Where each kind of page or\nfile sits is decided here, by the *_path functions, and nowhere else.\n\nContent is read only through the published-only queries (`list_published`,\n`get_published`), so a draft cannot reach a page, a link, or the navigation.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports, settings\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* The public site's one stylesheet, at style.css in the site's root. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\n.header-home { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n.nav-site ul { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 1rem; list-style: none; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; padding: 0; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n/* Markdown tables, in a Data Bite's or Report's body. A wide one scrolls\n   sideways in its wrapper (app.rendering.TABLE_SCROLL) rather than widening\n   the page; on a phone, rather than squeezing its text to a word a line. */\n.content-body .content-table-scroll { margin-block: 1rem; overflow-x: auto; }\n/* Chart images (app.chart_images) shrink to the column, keeping their shape. */\n.content-body img { height: auto; max-width: 100%; }\n.content-body table { border-collapse: collapse; }\n.content-body th, .content-body td { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; }\n.content-body th { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent); font-weight: 600; }\n@media (max-width: 40rem) { .content-body th, .content-body td { min-width: 10ch; } }\n\"\"\"\nRECENT_DATA_BITES = 5  # on the home page; the rest are on the Data Bites list\n\n\ndef data_bite_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"data-bites/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef data_bite_image_path(slug: str, name: str) -> str:\n    return f\"images/data-bites/{slug}/{name}\"\n\n\ndef report_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"reports/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef report_file_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    # .pdf, not the upload's own extension: a Report's file is always a PDF (T05).\n    return f\"reports/files/{slug}.pdf\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Page:\n    path: str      # where the page sits in the site, relative to its root\n    template: str\n    context: dict = field(default_factory=dict)\n    # The chart images its body may show, {name: path in the site}.\n    images: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n\n    def render(self) -> str:\n        root = \"../\" * self.path.count(\"/\")\n\n        def image_src(name: str) -> str | None:\n            path = self.images.get(name)\n            return None if path is None else f\"{root}{path}\"\n\n        return templates.env.get_template(self.template).render(\n            image_src=image_src,\n            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, root=root, css_path=f\"{root}style.css\",\n            home_path=f\"{root}index.html\", nav_reports=reports.list_published(),\n            data_bite_path=data_bite_path, report_path=report_path,\n            report_file_path=report_file_path, **self.context)\n\n\ndef home() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"index.html\", \"public/home.html\",\n                {\"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()[:RECENT_DATA_BITES]})\n\n\ndef data_bite_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"data-bites/index.html\", \"public/data_bites.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Data Bites\", \"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()})\n\n\ndef data_bite(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Data Bite's page; None for a draft or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else _data_bite_page(bite)\n\n\ndef _data_bite_page(bite: sqlite3.Row) -> Page:\n    return Page(data_bite_path(bite[\"slug\"]), \"public/data_bite.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": bite[\"title\"], \"bite\": bite},\n                images={name: data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name)\n                        for name in data_bites.images(bite[\"id\"])})\n\n\ndef data_bite_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Data Bite's chart image, at\n    data_bite_image_path(slug, name) in the site, is stored. None for a\n    draft, no such image, or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else data_bites.images(bite[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef report_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"reports/index.html\", \"public/reports.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Reports\", \"reports\": reports.list_published()})\n\n\ndef _stored_file(report: sqlite3.Row) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where the Report's file is stored, if it has one and it is there.\"\"\"\n    if report[\"file_name\"] is None:\n        return None\n    stored = reports.file_path(report[\"id\"])\n    return stored if stored.is_file() else None\n\n\ndef report(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's page, linking its file only if that can be\n    downloaded; None for a draft or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else _report_page(found)\n\n\ndef _report_page(found: sqlite3.Row) -> Page:\n    return Page(report_path(found[\"slug\"]), \"public/report.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": found[\"title\"], \"report\": found,\n                 \"has_file\": _stored_file(found) is not None})\n\n\ndef report_file(slug: str) -> tuple[Path, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's attached file, at report_file_path(slug) in the\n    site, as (where it is stored, its display name). None for a draft, a\n    Report with no file, or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    stored = found and _stored_file(found)\n    return (stored, found[\"file_name\"]) if stored else None\n\n\ndef pages() -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Every page of the site: what `cms publish` writes.\"\"\"\n    return [home(), data_bite_list(), report_list(),\n            *map(_data_bite_page, data_bites.list_published()),\n            *map(_report_page, reports.list_published())]\n\n\ndef files() -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file the site's pages link to besides the stylesheet, as\n    {path in the site: where it is stored}: the published Data Bites' chart\n    images and the published Reports' files.\"\"\"\n    images = {data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name): path\n              for bite in data_bites.list_published()\n              for name, path in data_bites.images(bite[\"id\"]).items()}\n    stored = {found[\"slug\"]: _stored_file(found) for found in reports.list_published()}\n    return {**images, **{report_file_path(slug): path for slug, path in stored.items() if path}}\n\"\"\"Markdown to safe HTML: the one pipeline every rendering of user-written\nMarkdown goes through, the admin preview now and the public export later.\n\nmarkdown-it-py renders (raw HTML in the Markdown is let through to it), then\nnh3 sanitizes, dropping <script>, event-handler attributes, javascript: URLs,\nand anything else not on its allowlist. The stored body stays raw; only this\nfunction's output is ever marked safe.\n\nTwo additions to nh3's allowlist, both for Markdown tables:\n  - `style` on a table cell, but only as exactly `text-align:left|right|center`,\n    so a column's alignment (`|---:|`) survives and nothing else does.\n  - the class TABLE_SCROLL on a <div>: each Markdown table is wrapped in one, so\n    a wide table can scroll sideways without restyling the <table> itself.\n\nAnd one addition to Markdown, for chart images (ADR-004): an image whose URL\nis `image:<name>` gets its URL from the `image_src` the caller passes, which\nknows the item's images and where the page being rendered finds them. A name\nit doesn't know, or no `image_src`, renders nothing. Any other image URL is\nleft to the sanitizer.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\nfrom markupsafe import Markup\n\nTABLE_SCROLL = \"content-table-scroll\"\nIMAGE_REFERENCE = \"image:\"\n# A chart image's name -> its URL from the page being rendered; None if the\n# item has no image of that name.\nImageSrc = Callable[[str], \"str | None\"]\n\n_MARKDOWN = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\").enable(\"table\")\n_MARKDOWN.add_render_rule(\"table_open\", lambda self, tokens, idx, options, env: (\n    f'<div class=\"{TABLE_SCROLL}\">\\n' + self.renderToken(tokens, idx, options, env)))\n_MARKDOWN.add_render_rule(\"table_close\", lambda self, tokens, idx, options, env: (\n    self.renderToken(tokens, idx, options, env) + \"</div>\\n\"))\n\n\ndef _chart_image_name(token) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The name in an `image:<name>` image token; None for any other image.\"\"\"\n    src = token.attrGet(\"src\")\n    return src.removeprefix(IMAGE_REFERENCE) if str(src).startswith(IMAGE_REFERENCE) else None\n\n\ndef _render_image(self, tokens, idx, options, env):\n    name = _chart_image_name(tokens[idx])\n    if name is not None:\n        url = env[\"image_src\"](name) if env.get(\"image_src\") else None\n        if url is None:\n            return \"\"\n        tokens[idx].attrSet(\"src\", url)\n    return self.image(tokens, idx, options, env)\n\n\n_MARKDOWN.add_render_rule(\"image\", _render_image)\n\n_TABLE_CELLS = (\"th\", \"td\")\n_ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES = {**nh3.ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES,\n                       **{cell: nh3.ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES.get(cell, set()) | {\"style\"}\n                          for cell in _TABLE_CELLS}}\n_TEXT_ALIGN = re.compile(r\"\\s*text-align\\s*:\\s*(left|right|center)\\s*\", re.I)\n\n\ndef _cell_alignment(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Keep a table cell's `style` only as its text-align, and only if that is\n    one of the three a Markdown table writes; drop every other declaration.\"\"\"\n    if attribute != \"style\":\n        return value\n    if tag not in _TABLE_CELLS:\n        return None\n    for declaration in value.split(\";\"):\n        if match := _TEXT_ALIGN.fullmatch(declaration):\n            return f\"text-align:{match.group(1).lower()}\"\n    return None\n\n\ndef render_markdown(text: str, image_src: ImageSrc | None = None) -> Markup:\n    \"\"\"`text` as sanitized HTML, its `image:<name>` references resolved by\n    `image_src`.\"\"\"\n    return Markup(nh3.clean(_MARKDOWN.render(text or \"\", {\"image_src\": image_src}),\n                            attributes=_ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES,\n                            attribute_filter=_cell_alignment,\n                            allowed_classes={\"div\": {TABLE_SCROLL}}))\n\n\ndef images_without_description(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The names in `text`'s `image:<name>` references that have no\n    description (alt text), in order, for the edit page to warn of: a screen\n    reader skips an image with an empty alt.\"\"\"\n    return [name for block in _MARKDOWN.parse(text or \"\") for token in block.children or []\n            if token.type == \"image\" and not token.content.strip()\n            and (name := _chart_image_name(token)) is not None]\n\"\"\"`cms publish`: write the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nThe pages and files come from app.public_site, the same ones the app serves,\nat the same paths, so the export is the live public site rather than a second\nrendering of it. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"reports/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import public_site, settings\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Regenerate `out` (site/ by default) from scratch, so a page taken down\n    since the last publish is gone from it too.\"\"\"\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    # UTF-8, as the app serves them, whatever this machine's locale.\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(public_site.CSS, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for page in public_site.pages():\n        _target(out, page.path).write_text(page.render(), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for path, stored in public_site.files().items():\n        shutil.copyfile(stored, _target(out, path))\n    return out\n\n\ndef _target(out: Path, path: str) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where `path` in the site goes under `out`, its folder made.\"\"\"\n    target = out / path\n    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    return target\n__init__.py\n__pycache__\nadmin.py\nauth.py\ndata_bites.py\npublic.py\nreports.py\nusers.py\n\"\"\"Data Bites in the admin console. import TestClient\n\nfrom app import chart_images, settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from, post_form, second_analyst\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE, create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t07_public_site import crawl, published_bite\nfrom tests.test_t08_publish import exported\nfrom tests.test_t09_tables import content_body\n\n\ndef _chunk(kind: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:\n    return struct.pack(\">I\", len(data)) + kind + data + struct.pack(\">I\", zlib.crc32(kind + data))\n\n\ndef png_bytes(pixel: bytes = b\"\\xff\\x00\\x00\", *, text: bytes = b\"\") -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"A real 1x1 PNG of one RGB pixel, with an optional tEXt chunk to pad it.\"\"\"\n    return (b\"\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n\"\n            + _chunk(b\"IHDR\", struct.pack(\">IIBBBBB\", 1, 1, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))\n            + (_chunk(b\"tEXt\", b\"Comment\\x00\" + text) if text else b\"\")\n            + _chunk(b\"IDAT\", zlib.compress(b\"\\x00\" + pixel))\n            + _chunk(b\"IEND\", b\"\"))\n\n\n# A real PNG, and minimal JPEG and WebP files with the right signatures.\nPNG = png_bytes()\nJPEG = b\"\\xff\\xd8\\xff\\xe0\\x00\\x10JFIF\\x00\\x01\\x01\\x00\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x01\\x00\\x00\" + b\"\\x00\" * 32 + b\"\\xff\\xd9\"\n_VP8L = b\"VP8L\" + struct.pack(\"<I\", 5) + b\"\\x2f\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00\" + b\"\\x00\"\nWEBP = b\"RIFF\" + struct.pack(\"<I\", 4 + len(_VP8L)) + b\"WEBP\" + _VP8L\n\n\ndef png(name: str = \"fall-by-class.png\", content: bytes = PNG, declared: str = \"image/png\"):\n    return (name, content, declared)\n\n\ndef upload(c: TestClient, bid: str, file, *, with_csrf=True):\n    data = {\"csrf_token\": csrf_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)} if with_csrf else {}\n    return c.post(f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/images\", data=data,\n                  files={\"file\": file}, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef delete_image(c: TestClient, bid: str, name: str, *, with_csrf=True):\n    return post_form(c, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/images/{name}/delete\", {},\n                     with_csrf=with_csrf)\n\n\ndef stored(bid: str) -> list[str]:\n    folder = settings.UPLOADS / \"images\" / \"data-bites\" / bid\n    return sorted(p.name for p in folder.iterdir()) if folder.exists() else []\n\n\ndef edit_bite(c: TestClient, bid: str, **override):\n    return post_form(c, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}\", {**BITE, **override})\n\n\n# Uploading, listing, replacing, deleting\n\ndef test_analyst_uploads_an_image_and_the_edit_page_lists_it_with_a_snippet(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    bid = create_bite(analyst)\n\n    response = upload(analyst, bid, png())\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}\"\n    page = analyst.get(f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}\").text\n    assert \"![Description](image:fall-by-class.png)\" in page\n    assert stored(bid) == [\"fall-by-class.png\"]\n\n    served = analyst.get(f\"/admin/data-bites/{bid}/images/fall-by-class.png\")\n    assert served.status_code == 200 and served.content == PNG\n    assert served.headers[\"content-type\"] == \"image/png\"\n    assert served.headers[\"x-content-type-options\"] == \"nosniff\"\n\n\ndef test_any_analyst_or_the_director_uploads_to_any_data_bite_draft_or_published(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    riley = second_analyst(director)\n    draft = create_bite(client_as(\"editor\"))\n    published = published_bite(client_as(\"editor\"), slug=\"spring-survey\")\n\n    for c, bid in ((riley, draft), (riley, published), (director, draft), (director, published)):\n        name = f\"chart-{len(stored(bid))}.png\"\n        assert upload(c, bid, png(name)).status_code == 303\n        assert name in user list, as HTML.\"\"\"\n    for row in director.get(\"/admin/users\").text.split(\"<tr\")[1:]:\n        if email in row:\n            return row\n    raise AssertionError(f\"{email} is not content row's timestamps into the past, so an edit\n    made within the same second still visibly changes updated_at.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {table} SET created_at = '2026-01-05 09:00:00',\"\n                     \" updated_at = '2026-01-05 09:00:00' WHERE id = ?\", (row_id,))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef seeded_db(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"UPLOADS\", tmp_path / \"uploads\")\n    db.init_db()\n    for role, user in DEMO_USERS.items():\n        users.create_user(user[\"email\"], user[\"password\"], role)\n    return settings.DATABASE_PATH\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client() -> TestClient:\n    return TestClient(create_app())\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client_as():\n    \"\"\"Return a factory:
